entities.summary: Tan Tock Seng was a performers & entertainers in Malacca (1798, Malacca – 1850), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
